stem.text: Chlorogenic acid is found in green coffee beans and is used in treatments for weight loss.

stem.label: chlorogenic acid
stem.alt: Skeletal structure of chlorogenic acid: a cyclohexane ring with HO and CO2H on one carbon and two OH groups on ring carbons, with an ester linked to an alkene chain ending in R.

stem.text: $R = \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{O}_2$ and takes no part in the reaction with sodium carbonate.
What is produced in good yield when chlorogenic acid is treated with an excess of sodium carbonate solution at room temperature?

A.alt: Skeletal structure: a cyclohexane ring with HO and CO2Na on one carbon and two OH groups on ring carbons, with an ester linked to an alkene chain ending in R.

B.alt: Skeletal structure: a cyclohexane ring with NaO and CO2Na on one carbon, NaO on a ring carbon and ONa on another, with an ester linked to an alkene chain ending in R.

C.alt: Skeletal structure: a cyclohexane ring with NaO and CO2H on one carbon, NaO on a ring carbon and ONa on another, with an ester linked to an alkene chain ending in R.

D.alt: Skeletal structure: a cyclohexane ring with HO and CO2Na on one carbon and OH groups on two other ring carbons.
Skeletal structure: HO–C(=O)–CH=CH–R, an acrylic acid with R on the alkene.
